questions.stem: Find all values of x ≠ 0 in (−π, π) satisfying 8^(1 + cos x + cos²x + … ∞) = 4³.
questions.notes: The exponent is the infinite series 1 + cos x + cos²x + … ; written with ^( ) because the run is too long to set as a Unicode superscript.
